replacements.3D animation for live events is content:
3D animation for live events is content that moves with purpose: characters, particles, simulations, and rendered worlds built by our Portland, Oregon team to play on screens, projections, and LED walls at productions nationwide. Motion capture takes it further: cameras and depth sensors track a real person's body and translate it into a digital performance in real time.

You need these tools whenever the experience should respond to the people inside it. An AR mirror that mirrors your movements, a flock of fish that scatters when you reach toward it, an avatar minted from your own body scan. These moments feel like magic to guests, and they're powered by motion capture pipelines and real-time 3D engines.

The difference between a gimmick and a memory is craft. Tracking has to be fast and stable, animation has to feel alive, and the system has to run flawlessly for hours of continuous foot traffic. That's the work we do.

replacements.Venue sourcing is the search for a physi:
Venue sourcing is the search for a physical space that can actually hold your event, creatively and technically. Beatrox runs that search from Portland, Oregon for productions nationwide. It's easy to find a room; it's harder to find one with the footprint, ceiling height, power, load-in access, and neighborhood character your experience demands, at terms your budget can survive. Booking is the second half: negotiating the contract, deposits, insurance requirements, and house rules that govern what you're allowed to build.

For experiential work, this step carries extra weight. Immersive environments, projection mapping, and interactive installations impose requirements a standard ballroom rarely meets, which is why the most memorable activations often happen in raw warehouses, shuttered retail, rooftops, and public parks. Those spaces deliver unmatched creative freedom, but they also demand a producer who can assess feasibility and negotiate with landlords and municipalities who don't deal with events every day.

You need venue sourcing support whenever the space itself is part of the concept, or whenever you simply can't afford to discover a venue's deal-breakers after the deposit clears.
